notes:
- Product overview: Salient builds post-call brief engine for mid-large contact centers (agent-facing briefs, QA scoring, manager coaching highlights).
- Primary ask: high-fidelity post-call summaries (3 sections: TL;DR, QA score w/ rubric, coaching highlights + suggested coach script). Also automatic ticket creation in Zendesk/SF when certain intent triggers.
- Workload profile: mix of streaming agent-assist (live) + nearline post-call summarization. Current baseline: 400 concurrent agents, peak spikes up to ~1,200 simultaneous calls (holiday/promotions).
- Latency targets: post-call summary available within 15s of call end for 95% p95; agent-assist query latency <300ms for short prompts (context windows 2-4 turns).
- Throughput & cost: cost-sensitive — prefer routing expensive models only for QA/regression checks; cheap distilled/open-quant models for routine briefs. Ask: intelligent routing + automatic fallback to quantized variants.
- Model preferences: open weights ok (Mistral/LLama-family) but want Redwood-verified perf profile. Need GPU-optimized inference and quantization recommendations from Optimize.
- Integrations: Twilio call webhooks, real-time transcript stream (WebSocket), Zendesk ticket create (function/tool calling), GDrive/CRM attachments. Request stub for function-calling schema to populate ticket fields.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS, audit logs retention 3+ years, optional data residency in us-east and eu-west. Legal has questions re: retention for recordings and PII redaction — prefer private deployment or dedicated with VPC.
- POC plan (proposed): 4 weeks — week1 ingest pipeline + sample transcripts, week2 integrate live stream + ticket creation, week3 QA rubric validation + latency tuning, week4 run 1,000-call soak test and produce evaluation report.
- Quote from Head of CX: "We need briefs that agents trust — not fluff. QA scores must map to our current rubric."
- Internal notes: finance wants ARR range estimate before exec sponsor; security asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 artifacts (SEC-77).
- Links: Fireflies ff_20260218_9b2c for initial demo; pricing deck in Drive.
- Risk: If Redwood cannot demonstrate reliable fallback under sustained 1,200-call spikes, they will push to managed vendor with on-prem option.
